units.source_text: 他略胖的脸，洗得十分干净，仿佛连皱纹的深处都洗净了。

en.t: His slightly plump face had been washed perfectly clean, as if even the depths of its wrinkles had been scrubbed clean.

units.source_text: 今天他的气色确实好极了，似乎感到心满意足。

en.t: Today his complexion was truly excellent, and he seemed to feel completely satisfied.

units.source_text: 在闷热的夜晚，那衣服的惠李声清晰可闻，令人感到一阵凉爽。

en.t: On the sultry night, the rustle of those clothes could be heard clearly, bringing a momentary feeling of coolness.
